name: v24-pf-AE04-lore-cancel
objective: v2.4 post-freeze AE04-L1 live gate (commit 70b8eed, src/runtime/loreSelect.ts: `this.cache` is written only when the run still owns its world AND every judge chunk answered). The real judge plugin answers the lore calls; an in-page fetch wrapper holds exactly ONE /systemone request per case. Case 1 (unanswered): the held request is ended by the lore timeout (LORE_TIMEOUT_MS), so the judge records a fallback; the next select at the SAME message (same chat, story, version, message id and scope = same cache key) must ask the judge again (cached:false, a new lore call in the judge ring). Case 2 (lapsed): after a compact line (new key) the held request is cancelled by rt.invalidateRuns() (the epoch bump every chat change / story load runs), the select answers null; the next select in the same chat/story/message must ask again. Frozen 4ebe1db cached {entries:[],picks:[]} unconditionally, so in both cases the second select answered {cached:true,picks:[]} with no judge call: both DEFECT branches fire on it. CONTROL (each case): once a call ANSWERS, the next select at that message must be a cache hit (cached:true, zero lore calls, zero requests) serving the same picks, which proves the fixture can see a cache hit and that the fix did not disable caching. The fetch wrapper and the force listener are removed in a finally, and a dry getWorldInfoPrompt flushes any pending forced entries so none leak into a later scan. judge.enabled + uses.loreSelect (and no other use) are switched on install-wide from the recorded starting state, and put back by the last step (the runner's restoreJudgeConfig restores them again; diff a run header around the run). The marker book SO-PF-AE04 Lore is deleted after each run with so-assets remove --marker SO-PF-AE04.

requires.why: the lore-select calls are answered by the real judge plugin, whose key a no-model lane removes

Only Ponticius knows it.' }, { comment: 'Back room password', keys: ['zqx-pass'], content: 'The password to the guild back room is amber heron. Ponticius changes it every winter.' }, { comment: 'Trade route 1', keys: ['zqx-route-1'], content: 'Hallow Ford trades salt for amber with Silt Harbor every spring.' }, { comment: 'Trade route 2', keys: ['zqx-route-2'], content: 'Brine Cross trades wool for rope with Greywick every summer.' }]; for (const entry of entries) { const result = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'upsertLorebookEntry', lorebook: 'SO-PF-AE04 Lore', comment: entry.comment, keys: entry.keys, content: entry.content }, { requirements: { lorebooks: ['SO-PF-AE04 Lore'] } }); if (!result.ok) throw new Error(`entry ${entry.comment}: ${result.message}`); } rt.refreshRequirements?.(); if (!rt.getSnapshot().requirements.ready) throw new Error(`requirements not ready: ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().requirements)}`); return { book: 'ready', entries: entries.length };

steps.send: Ponticius, what do you guard in the vault under the hall? Tell me how it opens.

'configured', model: status.model };

[]).map((message) => String(message?.mes ?? '')).reverse(); await ctx.getWorldInfoPrompt(chat, 8192, true, { personaDescription: '', characterDescription: '', characterPersonality: '', characterDepthPrompt: '', scenario: '', creatorNotes: '', trigger: 'normal' }); }; const trail = []; const reask = async (from, what) => { let answered = from.calls.some((call) => !call.fallback) ? from : null; for (let attempt = 1; !answered && attempt <= 3; attempt += 1) { const again = await ask(`re-ask ${attempt}`); trail.push(again); if (again.result?.cached !== false || again.asked < 1) throw new Error(`DEFECT (AE04-L1): after ${what}, a later select at the same message was served from the cache instead of asking: ${JSON.stringify({ trail, net })}`); if (again.calls.some((call) => !call.fallback)) answered = again; } if (!answered) throw new Error(`the judge did not answer a lore call in 4 tries, so the cache control measured nothing: ${JSON.stringify({ trail, net })}`); const control = await ask('control: same message after an answered call'); trail.push(control); if (control.result?.cached !== true || control.asked !== 0 || control.requests !== 0) throw new Error(`CONTROL: an ANSWERED selection at the same message must be served from the cache without asking; without that, this fixture cannot tell a cache hit from a re-query: ${JSON.stringify({ trail, net })}`); if (JSON.stringify(control.result.picks) !== JSON.stringify(answered.result?.picks ?? null)) throw new Error(`CONTROL: the cache hit served other picks than the answered call made: ${JSON.stringify({ trail })}`); return answered; }; try { fault = 'timeout'; const first = await ask('held past the lore timeout'); trail.push(first); if (net[0]?.fault !== 'timeout' || net[0]?.outcome !== 'aborted') throw new Error(`the held judge call was not ended by the lore timeout, so no unanswered call was measured: ${JSON.stringify({ trail, net })}`); if (!first.result || first.result.cached !== false || first.result.picks.length || !first.calls[0]?.fallback) throw new Error(`the unanswered call should answer uncached, with no picks and a recorded fallback: ${JSON.stringify({ trail, net })}`); if (ctx.chat.length - 1 !== first.lastId) throw new Error('the chat moved during the case, so the next select would not hit the same cache key'); const second = await ask('same message, after the unanswered call'); trail.push(second); if (second.lastId !== first.lastId) throw new Error('the chat moved between the two selects'); if (second.result?.cached !== false || second.asked < 1) throw new Error(`DEFECT (AE04-L1): the unanswered lore call was cached as an empty pick and served at the same message: ${JSON.stringify({ trail, net })}`); const answered = await reask(second, 'an unanswered call'); return { case: 'unanswered (timeout)', unanswered: { fallback: first.calls[0].fallback, heldMs: net[0].heldMs }, reasked: { asked: second.asked, requests: second.requests, picks: second.result.picks, fallback: second.calls.map((call) => call.fallback) }, answeredPicks: answered.result?.picks ?? null, trail, net }; } finally { window.fetch = original; ctx.eventSource.removeListener(forceEvent, onForce); await flush().catch(() => null); }

'active' : 'inactive'}, as the recorded install had it`); return { restored: true, offControl: true, enabled: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().judge.enabled, loreSelect: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().judge.uses.loreSelect };

_v26: Judge uses default ON since v2.6 rule 5 (user decision 2026-09-30, docs/plans/v2.6/00-overview.md), so the old 'must start off' precondition failed on every install. The fixture now records whatever the install holds, sets its OWN measured state (judge on, ONLY the measured use on, every other use off: the condition the gate was measured in when every use was off by default, and no other use's /systemone request can land in the fetch recorder), switches the measured use off again as a negative control before restoring, then restores the recorded settings and verifies them byte-for-byte; the runner's restoreJudgeConfig restores them again.
